verdict.rationale: 1Password documents an official Environments MCP Server that lets MCP clients such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kiro securely manage 1Password Environments without returning secrets to the agent. A runtime probe also completed a keyless initialize handshake against its official public docs MCP server (serverInfo "1Password Developer"). missing for 10: the Environments MCP Server is still Beta and limited to Environments rather than general vault/item access, no hands-on runtime verification of the Environments server itself, and no independent community corroboration.
